Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of
neck and low back pain and stiffness. Over the course of 16 visits, care consisted of
conservative management including manual therapy, stretching and strengthening
exercises, and modalities for pain control. Reported symptoms are consistent with the
mechanism and force of the impact described. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle
tenderness and reduced range of motion in the cervical and lumbar regions, while
neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. No
prior injury or treatment to the neck or back is known. Treatment progressed in a
typical fashion, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved. Billing records
reflect single charges for each service rendered without duplication. The patient is
improving and is expected to reach maximum benefit with a home exercise program.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
